79984.subject: The Agentic Bank Run is coming for banking’s cheapest money 🤖🏦; Anthropic’s IPO prospectus asks public investors…
79984.body:
View this post on the web at https://linas.substack.com/p/fintechpulse1132

Hey Everyone,
Good morning & happy Wednesday! Today, we’re breaking down Apollo’s “agentic bank run” warning & why Meta Muse threatens bank profits long before it threatens bank deposits (why most of the cash never leaves the banking system, which banks and fintechs win as AI agents start moving money, & the Q3 earnings number that will prove the thesis first + bonus deep dive into The Ultimate Guide to Grok Bot [ https://substack.com/redirect/20265ae6-0be2-4c75-9bfc-91499768e717?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], and The Agentic Transition Playbook [ https://substack.com/redirect/2fd54a74-195a-440e-86d8-c5836164c98b?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside), and diving into Anthropic’s leaked IPO prospectus & why the $2T listing is really a way to pay for $518B of compute commitments (why the headline $42B loss is mostly an accounting entry rather than cash out the door, why nearly half of sales run through cloud giants like Amazon & Google that also own a piece of Anthropic & compete with it, & what to watch for next + bonus deep dive into The Top 10 Stocks Positioned to Benefit Most from Anthropic IPO [ https://substack.com/redirect/1ffed0cc-b8a5-409a-aadb-04a7a75edf0f?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] & The Complete Guide on How to Use Claude Opus 5.5 [ https://substack.com/redirect/5ce77acb-7b2d-4fc2-b01f-42b46ae87b70?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside). So let’s just jump straight into the fascinating stuff 🌶️
The Agentic Bank Run is coming for banking’s cheapest money 🤖🏦
The news 🗞️ The “agentic bank run” Apollo’s Torsten Slok warned about on Sunday threatens bank profits long before it threatens bank deposits, and investors are already pricing it.
In a note titled “Is an Agentic Bank Run Coming?”, Slok argued that AI agents such as Meta’s Muse [ https://substack.com/redirect/35b11a0f-3243-4608-b722-3471b1294560?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] could soon sweep household cash from checking accounts paying a 0.1% national average into fintech accounts paying 3.3% to 5%. If every household did it, he wrote, banks “could lose a large share of the cheap deposits they rely on to make loans.”
It’s worth noting that banks were already part of the selloff we covered earlier this week [ https://substack.com/redirect/62a56360-3f3c-4d9f-969b-0a0c1a7a1f29?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], when Goldman Sachs’ consumer inertia basket lost more than 7% in six sessions and Schwab fell 6.1%. JPMorgan Chase and Wells Fargo each fell more than 3% in a single session last week as Muse climbed the app charts.
